title: Epitech Strasbourg
description: Optional modpack to enhance your Epitech Minecraft Server experience!
body:
Recommended modpack for playing on the Epitech Strasbourg server!

The modpack contains purely client-side game modifications, as well as client-side mods that are enhanced by the server.

The mods contained in the modpack enhance your experience visually, as well as providing some practical utility (such as waypoints and an in-game voice chat).
